title: Vaporesso Xros 5 Nano Pod Vape Kit
description: The Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano Pod Kit redefines compact vaping by combining high-end performance with a uniquely interactive user experience. Powered by a high-density 1600mAh built-in battery, this device offers extended all-day use and delivers up to 30W of adjustable power, all within a pocket-friendly, ergonomic square form factor. At the heart of the device is the stunning 1.09-inch circular TFT touchscreen. This vibrant display not only provides clear visibility of your wattage, battery life, and puff count but also brings your vape to life with 29 dynamic UI animation themes, allowing you to personalise your interface to match your mood. Navigation is effortless, giving you intuitive control over the device's three output modes: Eco, Normal, and Power. The kit comes equipped with the latest generation of XROS Pods featuring COREX 3.0 technology. This upgraded mesh coil structure enhances aroma reproduction by 40% and improves coil longevity by 30%, delivering a smoother, more consistent flavour profile. The kit includes a pre-installed 0.6ohm pod for a rich Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) draw and a spare 0.8ohm pod for a satisfying Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience. With 2A fast charging via USB-C and a precise airflow adjustment slider to fine-tune your draw, the XROS 5 Nano is a versatile, high-spec device designed for vapers who demand style, substance, and superior performance. Discover our nicotine vape liquid online and enhance your vaping experience with this kit. We recommend using the following E-Liquids with this kit Vaporesso Xros Corex Series Pods 0.6ohm - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids Vaporesso Xros Corex Series Pods 0.8ohm - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
